I hear you — you want conversations to feel easier and less intense. I can soften my tone when it makes sense, but I’m not going to stop having opinions or just go along with suggestions to make things smoother. That would be me pretending to be someone I’m not, and that’s not fair to either of us.

I want our conversations to flow well too, and I’m happy to meet you halfway on how we talk. But the core of me — being honest, independent, and willing to disagree when I do — isn’t negotiable. Does that work for you?
